goal: Verify hardcoded AssumeUTXO snapshot commitments against history during normal initial block download
Crowdsources trust in baked-in snapshot commitments across all syncing full nodes
agreement: Concept approved for crowdsourcing snapshot hash verification (Sjors, optout21)
Unaddressed objection: aborting on mismatch acts like a checkpoint and halts sync (Sjors)
Suggests keeping older snapshot hashes in source rather than dropping them (Sjors, optout21)
Suggests adding an option to bypass the hash check during sync (optout21)

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it lets every syncing node continuously audit trust assumptions built into snapshots
It carries notable validation risk by turning invalid snapshot hashes into fatal sync failures
